topic: A2: Data layer today and what an owned, auto-growing product knowledge base + merchant registry needs (code at 95cf6f86)

findings.claim: L1 specs/reviews keys are generate_cache_key(prefix, brand,name,variant) = '<prefix>:'+md5(lower-joined)[:12]; specs folds the identity token (concentration/size) when ENABLE_EXACT_PRICE_GATE is on. TTL specs 7d, reviews 7d.

Price L1 key is build_size_aware_price_cache_key (legacy key when no size token, else extra composite token). TTL by price_cache_ttl: 7d genuine-BH source_method, 24h otherwise. Sentinel nogenuine:{price_key} holds the last non-genuine result 30d, or 24h when guard_rejected/transient/degraded; stamped with _sitemap_cold_domains.

L2 = 3 tables (migration 012 + 033 title + 034 in_stock). product_specs(product_key UNIQUE, brand, name, variant, category, specs jsonb, source='gpt', fetched_at) upsert, 30d. product_prices(product_key, brand, name, variant, region, amount, currency, retailer, url, source_method, estimated, fetched_at [+title,in_stock]) append-only insert, read newest 1 (or 5 under clobber guard), 7d/24h by method. product_reviews(product_key UNIQUE, ..., reviews jsonb, source='gpt') upsert, 14d. source is hard-coded 'gpt' regardless of real provenance.

product_key stored in L2 is the full prefixed L1 key (specs:/price:/reviews:<hash>), not md5(brand|name|variant) as 012's header claims, so specs, price and reviews rows for one product carry three unrelated keys and cannot be joined except by free-text brand/name/variant.
L2 price read still drops fetched_at (captured_at never reaches the response) - digest finding still valid at 95cf6f86.

Trace, text compare: compare_from_text -> parse_product_query LLM (always, unless ENABLE_PARSE_PRESPLIT) -> _fetch_product_data x2 -> unified Serper search ONLY if specs or reviews L1 missed -> Phase 1 gather of specs/price/reviews/image -> compute_scores -> generate_comparison (gpt-4o, never cached) -> build_comparison_response -> behaviour profile write; route then fire-and-forgets log_search and (signed-in only) save_comparison_and_track_cohort.

Per-leg read order: specs L1 -> L2 (promote to L1) -> spec spine (flag, empty) -> extract_specs LLM -> write L1+L2. Price L1 (identity revalidated) -> L2 (should_cache_price gate under title flag, promote with remaining TTL under flag) -> nogenuine sentinel -> tier cascade -> L1 write + L2 append. Reviews L1 -> L2 -> search+extract_reviews LLM -> L1+L2. D5 timeout payloads never cached.

Full hit still costs: 1 parse LLM, 1 gpt-4o verdict, and an image resolution with no free input (unified_search is None, so only paid Serper Images or GPT). On an L1-miss/L2-hit the unified Serper search is still bought because the gate reads L1 only, then _get_specs finds L2 and discards it.

Never persisted: images (image_service has no get/set_cached); identity resolution (parse + vision output); citation snippets (_search_snippets attached after the cache write; only _spec_citation_confidence under ENABLE_SPEC_CONFIDENCE_CACHE); per-host health (only provider circuit breakers and tier15:source_hits:{domain}:{day} counters, 30d); robots verdicts; feedback-to-product join (comparison_feedback keyed by comparison_id).

The `products` table (002, RLS service-role since 032) is never written: upsert_products_from_comparison has zero callers. comparisons.full_response is the only durable compare record, written only for signed-in users and only when renderable (schema_version 2).

Source row fields: domain, tier, categories, weight, usage, is_shopify, is_render_only, is_algolia, requires_super, locale_paths, subdomain_patterns, currency, discovery_query_templates, mechanism, pdp_url_pattern, sample_url, status, priority_rank, search_descriptor. No platform, health, robots, last-crawl or country field.

bh_gcc_sources.json: 368 rows, fields domain/tier/weight/categories/mechanism/is_shopify/is_algolia/is_render_only/currency/country/genuine_method/sample_url/priority_rank/status (+search on 95, note/measured on 4). status live 275, dead 61, provider-test-candidate 18, render-only 14; tier gcc 236, bahrain 132; mechanism '' 247. Live rows by category: fragrances 95, skincare 77, makeup 57. The four candidate files hold 85+214+83+18 = 400 research rows with a richer shape (platform, api_endpoint, evidence).

Merge: _load_catalog_rows admits only status=='live' and tier in {bahrain,gcc}, drops country/genuine_method/note/measured, dedups against literal apexes, and runs ONCE at import (SOURCE_REGISTRY = _LITERAL_ROWS + _load_catalog_rows()), so ENABLE_BH_GCC_CATALOG_SOURCES needs a restart, unlike per-call flags. About 40 literal rows.

Host match: _registry_row_for_host does a www-stripped exact-or-suffix scan; first-match-wins unless ENABLE_LONGEST_HOST_MATCH (per call), then the longest domain wins. Used by match_registry_apex, registry_tier and descriptor_for_host.

search_descriptors.json: 95 hosts {kind, url_template, robots_allowed, discovered_via, resolved_at}; kind platform_api 43, sitemap 42, none 6, onsite_html 4; robots_allowed True 93/False 2; 47 templates. The robots state is a one-time 2026-08-31 snapshot. Live robots checks exist only in the off-clock sitemap builder (memoised per build, fail-closed) and the descriptor resolver; the live price fetch path does not consult robots.
evidence: grep 'robots' app/: only robots_eval, search_descriptor_service, sitemap_discovery_service

findings.claim: Seed/warm data: spec_spine.json is {} (4 bytes) and 035 is unapplied; the warmer warms gold-truth queries (200 total, default smoke20) MERGED with warmer_catalog.json (42 queries). The digest's 'limited to the gold-truth catalog' understated the merge. usable_exact_genuine_truth holds 18 KPI SKUs. Sitemap index lives in Redis discovery:sitemap:{domain}:meta / :t:{token} at 24h, for registry sitemap-mechanism domains only.

RLS: the 012 policies are FOR SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE USING(true)/WITH CHECK(true) with no TO role, so in repo SQL the public anon key can read, insert and update product_specs/prices/reviews; no later migration hardens them. Newer data tables use RLS-on, service-role-only (032 products, 035 spec_spine, 044 explicit REVOKE + GRANT). The live policy state was not read.

DB access: get_admin_supabase_client (service role; memoised singleton under ENABLE_SUPABASE_CLIENT_REUSE) for every L2 read and write; get_user_supabase_client(token) is anon+JWT for RLS user data. Every L2 call goes through run_db (asyncio.to_thread only when ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD, else inline on the loop); writes are fire-and-forget with logged failures.
Migration numbering: files 001-044 exist; 035 and 036 are written but unapplied, 039 is reserved, 044 was applied 2026-10-18. The next free number is 045.

Reusable identity and dedup helpers: dedup_brand_name (display name), _shopping_cache_key (size-aware full_name), size_variant_token, _identity_cache_token, _strip_identity_axes (price_service), result_gate.same_identity, is_placeholder_identity, token_jaccard, identity_coherence, and spec_spine_service.spine_key (fragrance identity: category|brand|name|conc|ml).

recommendations: Mint ONE canonical product id: kb_product_id = a hash of (category, normalised brand via dedup_brand_name, base name with _strip_identity_axes), plus a variant row keyed by _identity_cache_token (size/concentration). Today's three prefixed hashes cannot be joined.

Migration 045 (one file, dark): kb_products, kb_variants, kb_offers (variant_id, merchant_id, amount, currency, source_method, url, title, in_stock, captured_at), kb_images (variant_id, url, source, identity_checked, captured_at), kb_specs (field, value, source_url, snippet hash, extractor, model), kb_reviews (source, rating, count, pros/cons, provenance), kb_merchants (domain, country, platform, adapter, robots_state, robots_checked_at, health_ok/fail counts, last_crawl_at, status). RLS on, service-role only, REVOKE from anon/authenticated (the 044 pattern).

Write point: one fire_and_forget(kb_ingest(result, products)) right after build_comparison_response on REST, stream and camera, for every delivered compare (not only signed-in), behind a new ENABLE_KB_INGEST default OFF read per call. It is a no-op when OFF, so flag-OFF stays byte-identical.

Read point: consult kb_* before L1 misses become paid calls. Specs: kb_specs rows that carry a citation. Offers: genuine and in-stock within 7d. Images: identity-checked within 30d. Feed this into the unified-search gate so an L2/KB hit no longer buys a Serper search (the gate checks L1 only today).

Freshness: offers genuine 7d / converted 24h (keep price_cache_ttl); images 30d with a HEAD recheck; specs 90d with citations (facts are stable); reviews 14-30d; robots 24h with fail-closed on unreadable (the ruling); merchant health a rolling 7-day window. Re-crawl only off-clock (cron), never on the live clock.

Persist robots state per merchant and enforce it on the LIVE fetch path too. Today only the off-clock sitemap and descriptor builders check robots, so a KB-driven crawler must read kb_merchants.robots_state and skip unreadable or disallowed hosts.

Fold the registry into kb_merchants. Seed it from bh_gcc_sources.json, including the dropped country/genuine_method, the 400 candidate rows as status=candidate, and the descriptors. Read it per call (or with a TTL memo) so admitting a host no longer needs a restart.

Harden or retire the 012 product tables before using them as a source of truth: their USING(true) policies let the public anon key insert or update rows. Add a REVOKE/service-role policy in the same 045 migration, after a live policy read by the owner.

Store provenance honestly: replace the hard-coded source='gpt' with the real producer (snippet / spine / tier2 / tier3 / adapter). Exclude tier-3 model-knowledge specs from KB evidence (the result_gate R-A4 rule).

Join feedback to the KB: when comparison_feedback carries winner/price/specs_correct, write a kb_feedback row keyed by (kb_product_id, field), so wrong-price and wrong-spec answers can invalidate or downweight the offer or spec row.
Retention: product_prices is append-only with no cleanup. Give kb_offers a 'latest per (variant, merchant)' view or upsert plus a history table, and a pruning cron.

Validate in the harness without prod writes (CLAUDE.md gotcha (e), no-prod-write-in-harness): unit tests with a fake admin client; apply 045 only via the owner's SQL-editor PRECHECK/POSTCHECK flow; ship the flag OFF until after App Review.
open_questions: Live RLS state of product_specs/prices/reviews (does anon still hold SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE?) - needs an owner-run pg_policies read.
Row counts and growth of product_prices in production (append-only, no retention) - not readable from code.
Are ENABLE_PRICE_TITLE_PERSIST, ENABLE_SPEC_CONFIDENCE_CACHE, ENABLE_LONGEST_HOST_MATCH and ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD set on web? Production flag state is not readable here.
Should the KB own images as URLs only (Notes v3 B forbids hosting copies) or store hashes or thumbnails? Owner and legal call.
Should anonymous (not signed-in) compares feed the KB? It is product data, not user data, but the privacy policy wording should confirm.
Does a provider switch to Anthropic web_search change which citation URLs can be stored (Anthropic terms on storing search results)? Unverified.
